# Project 47: Customer Support Knowledge Base

**Category:** 7. Customer, People & Community
**Status:** Pending. Not started; work begins only on the explicit command `Start Project 47`.

## Brief (from the source PDF)

Organizes common customer questions and approved answers into a searchable help center.

> Original: Common customer questions aur approved answers ko searchable help center mein organize karta hai.
